niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, app-like interfaces that feel finished and well-structured, with strong section hierarchy, clear labels, and balanced use of space. They like screens that show enough information to feel complete, but not so much that the layout feels crowded or visually noisy. They generally prefer lighter backgrounds, restrained styling, and concise copy, while still wanting obvious controls and clear action affordances.

criteria.description: The user prefers screens with strong visual hierarchy, clearly separated sections, and obvious grouping that makes the layout easy to scan.
The user prefers layouts that show enough content to feel complete and useful, with minimal dead space and a well-filled page.
The user prefers shorter, more direct copy and simpler presentation with less explanatory clutter or overly dense onboarding text.
The user prefers controls that are clearly actionable and easy to understand, such as visible toggles, chevrons, segmented choices, and distinct row actions.
The user prefers interfaces that feel complete, intentional, and polished rather than sparse, placeholder-like, or partially unfinished.
The user prefers a light, airy, restrained visual tone over dark, heavy, or overly dramatic styling.
The user prefers explicit, descriptive labels and status text that make settings and actions immediately understandable.
